example.title: Cunningham Lane Bridge, Cunningham Lane over the Pine River

brief: Tiny three-panel, pin-connected Pratt full-slope pony truss (the end posts slope all the way to the centre panel), 41 ft 3 in long and 12 ft 11 in wide with trusses about 6 ft high, serving two farms off a dirt lane. Deck of uneven sawn planks on five wooden joists carried by iron I-beam floor struts; lower lateral rods; seated on cylindrical concrete footings in steel forms with plank retaining walls at the banks. No separate railing: the low truss is the rail. A WEIGHT LIMIT 6 TONS sign stands at the approach; the lane is dirt and gravel between grass banks and bare trees.

traits.abutments: concrete cylinder footings with timber retaining walls
